sar.narrative: Customer C07987 and card C07987-K2 were investigated after risk score identified transaction 3503878 on 2016-12-01. The investigation identified 5 related transaction(s) totaling $500.00 from 2016-11-29 through 2016-12-04. The activity occurred through the online channel under product code R with billing region 264.0. Device profile DVC-2A348F201B was New for the account and used no recorded proxy classification. Graph traversal connected the activity to 4 mapped card(s) beyond the subject card: C01104-K2, C01983-K1, C06224-K2, C11309-K1. The observed behavior is assessed as card not present new device with fraud probability 0.96, supported by transaction, device, customer, and resolved-case evidence. The bank recommends the actions recorded in the associated case, including human approval for any card block or regulatory filing.
